QuestInfo.name: [Vanishing Journey] The Starting Point of the Arcane River
QuestInfo.0: No matter how you approach it, the world that Kima the Oarsman described is Maple World. Is it really below the Arcane River? Ask #bKima the Oarsman#k in Vanishing Journey.
QuestInfo.1: Kima the Oarsman said Maple World should be at the starting point of the Arcane River. He wants you to make a #bpaper boat#k that can flow upstream and send the news...
QuestInfo.2: You folded a paper boat as Kima said.
